postal_system.assignment_rule: Servicio Postal Mexicano (SEPOMEX / Correos de México) maintains the national five-digit postcode catalog. UPU documents five digits placed before the locality name and federative-entity abbreviation. Syntax, a prefix, settlement name, coordinate, INEGI code or synthetic fixture is not proof of a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: SEPOMEX publishes 2025 geographic postcode delimitations as 32 state SHP resources through datos.gob.mx under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. These can be official-source postal Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry only when the exact state resource, edition, attribution, license snapshot, schema, CRS and digest are pinned and the source topology is preserved. Catalog rows without matching release geometry remain non-geometric assignment objects. Repairs, generalisation, compression and generated gap surfaces are derived-review, never silently official.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, thoroughfare, exterior and interior numbers, building, floor, local or unit, settlement type and name, between-street and reference information, municipality or territorial demarcation, locality, federative entity, P.O. Box and five-digit postcode separately. UPU examples, official viewers and synthetic fixtures are not production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as polygon, multipolygon, settlement_assignment, route, po_box, organization, delivery_point, unknown or derived_review_surface. A catalog row, settlement, locality, block, point, buffer or model surface is not automatically an official postal polygon.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, an explicit reviewed relation to a permitted building or establishment identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, edition, validity, privacy, CRS and digest. A postcode, settlement, DENUE point, block, parcel, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact residential address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: INEGI geographic keys and the Marco Geoestadístico identify federative entities, municipalities or territorial demarcations, localities, settlements, roads, AGEBs and blocks. Preserve edition, code, producer, source-defined geo-statistical status, terms, CRS and digest; these objects remain distinct from SEPOMEX assignments and postal geometry.
postal_system.establishment_rule: DENUE supplies public economic-establishment identifiers, structured address fields and approximate coordinates under INEGI free-use terms. It covers businesses rather than every building or residence; some rural positions are locality centroids. It is context and an optional explicit establishment relation, not postcode geometry, residential-building authority, owner or occupant evidence.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Release-pinned SEPOMEX catalog rows and state SHP boundaries plus rights-cleared INEGI and community context may normalize input, validate joins, dissolve multipart code geometry, build spatial indexes, compress geometry, detect drift and generate mathematical or machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source resource, state, edition, license, input digests, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, CRS, confidence, uncertainty and official-source or derived-review status. It never fills unknown coverage or invents a street, number, unit, building, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate exact SEPOMEX assignments and official-source polygons, INEGI context, permitted civic addresses, explicit establishment or building relations and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling source objects or claiming AGID geometry is official Mexican postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The SEPOMEX 2025 state postal-boundary dataset catalog declares Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Pin the catalog and each of the 32 resource records, exact files, edition, attribution, license snapshot, schema, CRS and SHA-256 digest before use. The Correos national catalog, UPU publication, INEGI products and ODbL content retain separate terms, attribution and partitions.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO MX scope and stores federative-entity, municipality or territorial-demarcation, locality, settlement, postal, geo-statistical, cadastral, maritime, border and source-specific territorial representations independently. Postal, political-administrative, geo-statistical, address, establishment, building and AGID coverage, legal status and vintage must not be conflated or silently extended.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, exterior and interior numbers, references, coordinates, establishment records, lookup queries, property records, owners, recipients, organizations, credentials and logs can expose household, property, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private, owner-linked and query data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: SEPOMEX catalog assignments and 2025 state SHP resources, UPU 2017 guidance, the 2024 address standard, INEGI geographic-framework editions, DENUE editions, derived surfaces, building relations and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, resource and artifact version, state, edition, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet, GeoParquet or PMTiles partitions with exact attribution, release, state, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Real private addresses, query logs, restricted cadastral or owner-linked data and credentials stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery, a Space is demonstration and production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
